term: prender a cada santo una vela

1.consolidated_definition: . Mover muchas influencias para conseguir algo. “Aunque le prenda su abuelo —a cada santo una vela.” Cintrón, Bombones de sal, 1910, p. 116.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To exert many influences in order to achieve something. "Although his grandfather may intervene – each saint has a candle." Cintrón, Bombones de sal, 1910, p. 116.
